meta.notes: Lights out: a quiet mission as two. A relay post in a walled yard at night: the strongbox is behind a hall with a grille of four beams, a lens and a lamp, all on the mains; the breaker is in a generator shed on the far side of an inner wall, and the man sent to it has the mains back before one man can walk from it to the door. One waits by the door, the other throws the breaker on the word and hides.
